nodes.label: Universe CSV
nodes.description: /universe/universe.csv (id, text, date, label) + lexicon.json. The practice rows come with their labels; every other row (about 18,000) has an empty label and no form.

nodes.label: Two readers
nodes.description: Text to facts (subject, attribute, value). Arckan's ranker reads every row (fact F1 0.84 on held-out pages); X's simple extractor reads it again, and a fact both read gets more weight (right 95% of the time). Labelled rows are read by models that never saw their page.

nodes.label: KB: input labels + EM
nodes.description: Only the input's labelled rows pin it (a true row's gold form holds, a false row's value is forbidden); unlabelled rows vote, weighted by page trust learnt by EM; a new value needs a pin or 2 pages. Generated items only ask. A labelled row is itself judged by a KB without its page's labels.

nodes.label: Practice gold forms
nodes.description: data/practice.csv with its gold forms, baked into the image. A row whose label the input hides is left out.

nodes.label: Truth KB
nodes.description: A dated timeline per subject and attribute from the gold forms (units converted, rows of one date in row order). The source of truth for the claims and for the training items.

nodes.label: Training items
nodes.description: Labelled claims in all 5 types: true from the claim generator (facts that only reword a prose sentence are skipped), false by flipping the logic (another value, the reverse change, the opposite comparison), unsure from pairs nobody states.

nodes.label: Train
nodes.description: LightGBM on the labelled rows + the training items, every feature from the label-free KB. prod: all items; debug: half the items held out and scored.

nodes.label: Inference + trust
nodes.description: Labels every unlabelled row: true / false / unsure with a confidence (0.5 to 1, empty for unsure), plus a trust score (page trust, support, extraction) and the rows that support or contradict it.

nodes.label: ~18,000 labels
nodes.description: One label per unlabelled row; trust scores and sources go to the debug files, never to output.csv.

nodes.label: Claim generator
nodes.description: Templates from claim-forms.md: fact, compare, change, at_event and relation, built only from values the truth KB firmly supports.

nodes.label: Validator
nodes.description: Checks entry.schema.json, lexicon names, the claim-forms rules and novelty (not a reformulation of an input row). An invalid claim is sent back to be regenerated.

nodes.label: Writer
nodes.description: Writes a temp file in /output, then os.replace() to output.csv. A fallback table goes down early, and a watchdog writes again at the deadline.

nodes.label: output.csv
nodes.description: /output/output.csv: id, type, text, form, label, confidence. The labels plus exactly 1,000 new claims.
